description: This file defines the PdfViewerPreferences class, which models the viewer preferences dictionary in a PDF document. It provides properties to configure how the PDF viewer should display the document, such as hiding toolbars, setting window position, and reading direction.

classes.name: PdfViewerPreferences
classes.description: Represents the PDF document viewer preferences dictionary, allowing configuration of viewer display options.

classes.name: PdfViewerPreferences.Keys
classes.description: Contains constant string keys corresponding to viewer preferences in the PDF dictionary.

methods.name: HideToolbar
methods.description: Gets or sets whether to hide the viewer application's toolbars when the document is active.

methods.name: HideMenubar
methods.description: Gets or sets whether to hide the viewer application's menu bar.

methods.name: HideWindowUI
methods.description: Gets or sets whether to hide user interface elements like scroll bars, leaving only the document content.

methods.name: FitWindow
methods.description: Gets or sets whether to resize the window to fit the first displayed page.

methods.name: CenterWindow
methods.description: Gets or sets whether to center the document window on the screen.

methods.name: DisplayDocTitle
methods.description: Gets or sets whether the window’s title bar displays the document title from the info dictionary.

methods.name: Direction
methods.description: Gets or sets the prevalent reading order for text, either LeftToRight or RightToLeft.
